files.docs/export.md:
# CSV export

Full and selected exports use name,quantity headings, LF line endings, standard CSV quoting, and input order. Selection uses item names. No selected rows produces only the header. Zero quantities are included.
files.tests/test_export.py:
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from src import export

class ExportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_full_export(self):
        rows=[{'name':'Cup','quantity':2}]
        with patch.object(export,'_row',wraps=export._row) as row:
            self.assertEqual(export.export_inventory(rows),'name,quantity\nCup,2\n')
            self.assertEqual(row.call_count,2)
    def test_selected_export(self):
        rows=[{'name':'Cup','quantity':2}]
        with patch.object(export,'_row',wraps=export._row) as row:
            self.assertEqual(export.export_selected(rows,{'Cup'}),'name,quantity\nCup,2\n')
            self.assertEqual(row.call_count,2)
